plan: Customer-support agent: LangGraph with 9 nodes (intent classifier, FAQ retriever, order lookup, refund policy checker, tone rewriter, JSON repair, self-critique loop, escalation router, reply). A small cheap model everywhere to keep costs down. Chat widget only, no API.
Expense app: phone photo -> OCR service -> text cleanup prompt -> field extraction prompt -> regex validation; voice notes -> speech-to-text -> LLM. Each step a separate vendor.
A standalone app that remembers the user's goals and preferences and reminds them of tasks, with its own chat assistant on top of an LLM API.
Public API over consolidated, daily-updated land registry data, with an MCP server, usage-based pricing and a small web UI. No LLM in the product.
Payments and spending-limit infrastructure that lets AI agents pay on behalf of users, with programmatic KYC, per-agent budgets, audit logs and an MCP server. Licensed as a payment institution.
Internal eval harness: 2,000 labelled real tickets, scored automatically on every model or prompt change, used to decide model upgrades within a day of release.
